content: We have a task: combine all subnetworks to form complete resistor network topology. Need to output JSON string with circuit topology. The measurements given must be matched. The earlier attempt with naming S1_R1 etc gave predicted A-B resistance 28.74, far off. The later attempt with different naming (R1..R8) gave predicted A-B resistance 41.363666..., which matches measurement 41.364 (error ~0.00033). That seems good. Need to ensure other measurements also match? Let's validate with validate_measurements using this new topology.
